blocks.text: Team preview of the Miami Heat ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last NBA season: 43-39, lost to Charlotte in play-in tournament elimination game. Coach: Erik Spoelstra (19th season, 830-611). Season opener: Oct. 21 vs. Minnesota. Departures: G Tyler Herro, C Kel’el Ware, F Jaime Jaquez Jr., G-F Norman Powell, G Kasparas Jakučionis, G Terry Rozier. Additions: F Giannis Antetokounmpo, G-F Klay Thompson, F-C Bobby Portis Jr., G Tim Hardaway Jr., C Nick Richards, G Ryan Conwell, G Tre Donaldson.
